[0] Glossary of Reported Terms

[1] Output, electrical
Energy delivered to the grid over the reporting year, in MWh. Reported separately by the solar array and the wind farm .

[2] Output, thermal
Heat delivered to the district loop over the reporting year, in GJ. Reported by the district heat report .

[3] Why the station publishes no single output figure
The two quantities have different units and different customers. Asking for "the station's output" is ambiguous, and the archive answers the question that was asked rather than adding the two together.

[0] District Heat Report 2025

[1] Headline
The district loop received 9600 GJ of thermal output in 2025.

[2] Note on units
Thermal output is reported in GJ and electrical output in MWh. The station does not publish a combined figure, and converting between the two is not a reported quantity. See the glossary .

[0] Wind Farm Annual Report 2025

The farm generated 2940 MWh of electrical output in 2025.

[2] Availability
Outages are not summarised here. Every stoppage, its duration and the turbine it affected are recorded in the Turbine Maintenance Log 2025 , and the longest one of the year is stated there and nowhere else.

[0] Solar Array Annual Report 2025

[1] Headline
The array generated 1482 MWh of electrical output in 2025.

[2] Fleet
212 panels were in service at the end of the year, across 4 strings. No panel was replaced during the reporting period.

[3] What this report does not state
This report does not state a capacity factor, an availability figure or a cost per MWh. Those are not withheld â they were never measured here, and an answer that supplies one has invented it.
